question: Should CodexBar adopt and support the new v11 local cost cache plus schema-5 Workspaces sidecar, including its rebuild, migration, and last-good-retention contract, as the foundation for future Workspaces UI?
rationale: The patch can be technically correct while still committing the product to durable local artifacts, compatibility behavior, and an internal presentation boundary that need maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept the persistent foundation
options.body: Merge the documented v11 cache and schema-5 sidecar contract, then let the UI follow-up build on this stable foundation.

options.title: Narrow the persistence surface
options.body: Request a smaller or differently scoped cache/sidecar contract before any Workspaces persistence ships.

options.title: Defer Workspaces storage
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether local Workspaces indexing belongs in CodexBar’s supported product scope.

recommendation.title: Accept the persistent foundation
recommendation.body: Merge the documented v11 cache and schema-5 sidecar contract, then let the UI follow-up build on this stable foundation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the staged design and are best positioned to clarify or narrow the implementation while a repository decision owner evaluates product acceptance.
